evidence_packets.current_change: National Data Property Registration Service System entered trial operation on 2026-09-11 with nationally interoperable registration results and public result query/verification.
observed_motion: The national system exposes search fields for registered data name, applicant and data overview.
Shanghai reported 15 of the first 56 national registration certificates on launch, across embodied intelligence, financial models, aviation/shipping, equipment operations and smart agriculture.
Shanghai data-product IP registration separately reported 1,592 certificates issued by end-July 2026 and 24 enterprises using data IP for RMB547m of pledge financing.
Pudong/SPDB publicly describes a data-asset financing solution spanning data-asset value discovery, exchange/valuation connections and customized data-asset enhancement/pledge finance.
decisive_gate_evidence: Shanghai's current official financing workflow still requires one-to-one enterprise-bank questioning, bank assessment of business condition, data-IP compliance and market value, comprehensive credit approval, then bilateral financing contract.

National registration institutions are Beijing International Big Data Exchange, Shanghai Data Exchange and Shenzhen Data Exchange; Shenzhen explicitly positions itself as a registration-to-circulation-to-assetization full-chain service.
No open standardized bank underwriting criteria, machine-callable multi-bank offer rail or operator-owned realized financing outcome graph was evidenced.

evidence_packets.current_change: China's electronic-document regulation took effect on 2026-09-01 and expressly covers systems that issue, store, amend, convert, transfer, pledge and circulate electronic documents.
observed_motion: Chongqing's digital NCD / single-document platform had already released more than RMB22m of financing since May 2026 by August.

On 2026-08-18 the central-bank-backed West Land-Sea Smart Finance platform connected directly to the unified movable-property financing registration system, allowing NCD pledge registration, cancellation and verification in one interface.
Bank of China Chongqing completed an eNCD digital-document pledge financing transaction through the integrated mechanism.
decisive_gate_evidence: The same public infrastructure already closes document issuance, financing application, pledge registration, bank disbursement and cargo-disposal workflow.
Banks can verify title and pledge records directly inside the incumbent infrastructure.
A separate router would not own the action right, registry, bank credit decision or document control rail.

evidence_packets.current_change: The national green-certificate issuance/trading system shows large current supply and transaction flow, while policy strengthens nationwide circulation and green-power consumption requirements.
observed_motion: The national system reported 1.970bn certificates issued and 481m traded in 2026 through July.
July alone recorded 54.68m certificate trades; 2026-production certificates averaged RMB6.10 per certificate in standalone trading.
Rules support nationwide circulation and recognized platforms including the national green-certificate trading platform, Beijing Power Exchange and Guangzhou Power Exchange.
decisive_gate_evidence: The official market already owns certificate identity, account registration, listing/bilateral/auction transaction and settlement synchronization.
Price information and a national green-certificate price index are public.
A generic comparison/selection layer can be reproduced by official-market data plus a general agent and does not create a distinct operator control asset.

evidence_packets.current_change: China's product carbon-footprint label certification pilot has moved into standardized implementation with a general rule, 17 product-specific rules and a regulated certification-institution set.
observed_motion: SAMR reported on 2026-09-14 that the pilot now has a general-plus-product-specific rule system and 17 product-specific implementation rules.
The pilot initially selected 26 certification bodies and covers product classes including batteries, photovoltaics, steel, aluminum, textiles, tires and electronics.
decisive_gate_evidence: Certification is a regulated professional judgment and trust function, not a commodity action API.

SAMR's 2026 quality-certification enforcement update says 10 participating carbon-footprint certification institutions had their pilot qualification cancelled after capability review, reinforcing that institutional competence is a hard controlled input.

A new operator can at most perform lead generation, document preparation or consulting unless it becomes/controls a qualified certification institution; those are recurring human-service paths rather than a founder-light routing asset.

excluded_observations.reason: Fresh consumer-side platform launch with unified booking, but the public platform itself already owns discovery-to-reservation for the advertised inventory; no missing external control edge was evidenced.

Large digitally traceable flow, but the subsidy identity/product/transaction verification rail is government/platform-owned and overlaps the project's existing used-device/recycling history; not admitted as a fresh formation.
Real financing support exists, but bank underwriting and policy eligibility remain lender/government-controlled; no operator-owned callable rail was observed.
